subject: general
question: Who is popular for designing the Indian Flag?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Pengali Venakya.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The design of the flag of India that was firstly presented in the year **1921 to Mahatma Gandhi,** leader of the All-India Congress, was created by **Pingali (or Pinglay) Venkayya**.
 
• **Venkayya **presented the flag design to Gandhi that Contains colours related to the two principal religions, Orange for the Hindus and green for the Muslim people of India.
 
• From the centre of the horizontally divided flag, **Lala Hans Raj Sondhi **suggested the addition of the traditional spinning wheel, which was related to Mahatma Gandhi’s crusade to make Indians self-reliant by fabricating their own clothing from local fibres.
 
• Gandhi modified the Indian flag by adding a white strip in the centre of the flag for the other religious communities in India, thus It also provides a clearly visible background for the spinning wheel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** led nonviolent resistance to lead the successful campaign for India's independence from British rule. 
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** was one-third of the **Lal Bal Pal **triumvirate. Tilak was the first leader of the Indian independence movement. 
 
• **Lala Hansraj** also known as Mahatama Hansraj, was an Indian educationist and a follower of Arya Samaj movement founder, **Swami Dayanand.**
